text: Pellet, Allah naadoyay ɓen gomɗimɓe Allah e Nulaaɗo Makko on, ɓe golli golle moƴƴe, Aljannaji ɗi canɗi ilata senngo ley kuɓeeje e leɗɗe majji. Ɓen non yedduɓe Allah e Nulaaɗo Makko on, hiɓe dakmitora aduna, jokkugol tuuyooji maɓɓe, ɓe ñaamira wano neemoraaɗi ɗin ñaamirta: ɓe himmiraa si wanaa deedi e farjuuji maɓɓe; hara non Ñalndɗ Darngal, ko Yiite ngen woni jaaƴorde maɓɓe.
